basic_profile.bio: I'm a 38-year-old software engineer based in Ljubljana, Slovenia. I have a deep passion for LEGO sets, especially Star Wars themed ones, and spend my weekends building and customizing them. I'm a big fan of podcasts, particularly those that delve into fantasy worlds, which sparked my interest in the Prancing Pony Podcast. When I'm not tinkering with code or LEGO bricks, I enjoy creating levels in Mario Maker 2. As a tech enthusiast, I often find myself helping others with Apple-related queries. I work a flexible schedule, so I'm usually online in the evenings after dinner. I'm single and enjoy the freedom it gives me to pursue my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in programming comes from a degree in Computer Science and over a decade of experience working in various tech companies. I've always been a self-learner, constantly updating my skills with the latest programming languages and technologies. My interest in LEGO and Star Wars is more of a lifelong passion, cultivated from childhood and sustained through community engagement on platforms like Reddit.
